input.query: SELECT 'abn' p, service_name, metric, COUNT(*) n, SUM(count) cnt, ROUND(SUM(sum)/NULLIF(SUM(count),0),3) mean FROM abnormal_metrics_histogram WHERE service_name IN ('ts-travel2-service','ts-travel-service','ts-route-plan-service') AND metric LIKE 'db.client%' GROUP BY ALL UNION ALL SELECT 'norm', service_name, metric, COUNT(*), SUM(count), ROUND(SUM(sum)/NULLIF(SUM(count),0),3) FROM normal_metrics_histogram WHERE service_name IN ('ts-travel2-service','ts-travel-service','ts-route-plan-service') AND metric LIKE 'db.client%' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 2,3,1

content.text: DB connection hold time roughly doubled on travel and travel2, but the individual SELECT spans stay short. I'll measure, across all slow queryInfo spans, how much of their time is explained by child spans.
